whatIs: unDraw is a frequently updated library of SVG illustrations. Before downloading you can change the main color to match your brand, and there are also PNG versions.
It's a good fit when you need clean images for a landing page, an onboarding flow or an error page without hiring an illustrator.
uses: Illustrating an app's empty state or 404 error screen.
Decorating a product's landing page with images in the brand's colors.
Accompanying the steps of an onboarding flow or a technical presentation.
caveats: Its own license allows commercial use without attribution, but prohibits redistributing the illustrations in packs, building integrations with them or using them to create a service that competes with unDraw.
They can't be used to train, fine-tune or test AI or machine learning systems without written permission.
The included logos are trademarks of their owners: use them only to represent that brand.
pricingNote: The library is free; unDraw Plus costs $59 (or $79 with videos), a one-time payment that gives one year of access to animated illustrations, custom graphics and extra styles.
idealFor: Teams and personal projects that want free SVG illustrations in their own colors.
